commands: lsuser -R files -a id home account_locked ALL
blurb: Every normal user account on the system has a home directory that should be owned by the account itself or by the root administrator. This control confirms that each active non-system account has a home directory that exists and is owned by the right account. If a home directory is missing or owned by someone else, that other user could plant or alter the login files and keys inside it and take over the account.
